resources.string: Detect installed apps that declare standard FCM/GCM receive components, then configure HyperOS Autostart for them.

Detection is best-effort and runs only when you tap Scan. Android does not let a normal app silently enable Autostart for other apps; doing that would require privileged methods that FCM Guard intentionally avoids.
Default: follow the system. This changes only the UI theme and adds no background work.
